content.short: TixHive is a blockchain-based ticketing app using NFTs to represent and track tickets.
content.description: TixHive is a blockchain-based ticketing app that uses non-fungible tokens (NFTs) to represent tickets, providing a secure, verifiable way to track, purchase, and transfer entries while reducing the risk of fraud. By recording ticket ownership and sales on the blockchain, it aims to increase transparency and efficiency and potentially lower costs by removing intermediaries. For attendees, it delivers a trusted method to buy and access tickets, with verifiable provenance and simplified event management.
